name: griddly-demo
//overrides: Every capability package peer-depends on `@tanstack/react-query` at `^5` and dev-depends on it at the same range. The CLI vendors them as `file:` deps, so bun installs those dev deps nested, and `^5` floats to a newer patch than the exact version apps/web pins -- two versions, so nothing hoists. Two copies is not a size problem: each has its own `QueryClientContext`, so a hook inside a capability package throws `No QueryClient set` under the app's own provider. Pin it here, next to the other cross-package singletons.
//overrides-diffs: `@pierre/diffs` is held at 1.6.2 because 1.6.3 (npm latest since 2026-11-03) was published with unresolved `workspace:*` and `catalog:` dependencies, which fail `bun install`. It arrives only through mistral-design-system's UI library, at `^1.5.1`, and only an override reaches a transitive dependency. Inert without that capability. Drop this pin once npm serves a fixed release past 1.6.3.
